title: SDSU 2026 SDAC Finale — Eric keynotes San Diego Angel Conference for 400+ investors and founders
summary: SDSU's 2026 San Diego Angel Conference finale brought together 400+ attendees — investors, startups, students, and San Diego ecosystem leaders — for a keynote from Eric on Incorruptible, alongside the announcement of the SDAC VIII Fund's $200,000 investment in Sesh.
blockquote: Thank you to Eric Ries for inspiring us as our keynote speaker, author of The Lean Startup Co., and for helping us celebrate his new book, Incorruptible.
blockquote_source: San Diego Angel Conference on LinkedIn
